meta.title: 摄影师要的“眼神力量感”到底怎么给❓
meta.title_en: How to Give the 'Powerful Gaze' Photographers Want?

scenes.title_cn: 开场：眼睛为什么看起来没有力量感？甚…
scenes.title_en: Opening: why do your eyes lack power? Phot…
sentences: 你越睁大就越没内容。
The more you open your eyes, the emptier they get.
open eyes empty（越睁越空）
眼神的力量感和穿透力，跟你的眼皮并没有关系。
The gaze's power has nothing to do with your eyelids.
not about the eyelids（与眼皮无关）
你的眼皮不管使了多少劲，眼睛都不会有劲。
No matter how hard you strain your lids, the eyes won't gain force.
straining fails（用力无效）
scenes.speak: The more you open your eyes, the emptier they get. The gaze's power has nothing to do with your eyelids. No matter how hard you strain your lids, the eyes won't gain force.

scenes.title_cn: 穿针引线：那问题来了，眼睛的力量感到…
scenes.title_en: Threading the needle: so what is the gaze'…
sentences: 玩一次穿针引线的游戏，你的目标把线塞到针眼里。
Play the threading-the-needle game—push the thread through the eye.
thread the needle（穿针引线）
有没有感觉自己的整个注意力和眼神汇聚在一个空气中的点上。
Doesn't your attention and gaze converge on a point in the air?
converge on a point（汇聚一点）
你认真看那个针的时候，眼睛是冲的，就是这感觉。
When you focus on the needle, your eyes engage—that's the feeling.
the feeling（就是这感觉）
paraphrase: converge on a point（汇聚一点
converge on a point（汇聚一点
scenes.speak: Play the threading-the-needle game—push the thread through the eye. Doesn't your attention and gaze converge on a point in the air? When you focus on the needle, your eyes engage—that's the feeling.

scenes.title_cn: 眼神发力：是不是以后能不叫我们按眼神…
scenes.title_en: Engaging the gaze: so we don't force power…
sentences: 这个就叫做眼神的发力，而不是瞪眼。
This is gaze engagement, not straining.
gaze engagement（眼神发力）
你穿针的时候没瞪眼皮吧，只需要专注地去看一个点。
You didn't strain while threading—just focus on one point.
focus on one point（专注一点）
那个穿透感就来了。
That's where the penetration comes from.
penetration comes（穿透感）
paraphrase: focus on one point（专注一点
focus on one point（专注一点
scenes.speak: This is gaze engagement, not straining. You didn't strain while threading—just focus on one point. That's where the penetration comes from.

practice: Straining your lids makes the gaze emptier.
Thread a needle and feel the attention converge.
Focus on one point to bring the penetration.
pitfalls: The more you open, the emptier it gets.
Power comes from focus, not the lids.
Concentrate on a single point instead.
It's gaze engagement, like threading a needle.
shifts: 用 penetration（穿透力）、gaze engagement（眼神发力）
用 lifeless（没力量感）、converge on a point（汇聚一点）
用 thread the needle（穿针引线）、focus on one point（专注一点）、the feeling（这感觉）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：眼睛没力量感、摄影师提醒、眼睛有劲一点、有力量一点、我有力了吗、有劲了吧、越挣大越没内容、力量感、穿透力、眼皮、使了多少劲、穿针引线、针、线塞进去、注意力、眼神、汇聚、空气中的点、认真看针、冲、眼神的发力、瞪眼皮、专注地看一个点、穿透感等。
